title: Finite free map near the generic point
statement: Let Z be an integral Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth, def-pc-integral-scheme] and G a coherent module [pqf-def-coherent]. There exist r ≥ 0, an open U containing the generic point ξ, and a map from the restriction to U of the free structure-module sheaf on ULift (Fin r) to G restricted to U, such that its stalk map at ξ in U is an isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

proof.text: Use a finite local generating family for G at ξ. Every germ is a linear combination of its germs because the generating map is locally surjective. The generic ring is the function field (Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry.FunctionField), so choose a finite basis of G_ξ. The stalk of a finite free sheaf is free on the same basis: finite tuples of germs have representatives on one common neighbourhood.

The finite free source is quasi-coherent with its standard finite generating family, hence coherent by the locally Noetherian criterion. Extend the basis isomorphism by the coherent stalk-map extension theorem. Its elementwise restriction-stalk equality identifies the new stalk map with the basis isomorphism conjugated by restriction-stalk isomorphisms, so it is invertible. Rank zero is allowed.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_generic_free_neighbourhood (Z : Scheme.{w}) [IsNoetherian Z]
    [IsIntegral Z] (G : Z.Modules)
    (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent Z.toRingedSpace G) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (U : Z.Opens) (hx : genericPoint Z ∈ U)
      (φ : (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
          (SheafOfModules.free (R := Z.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{w} (Fin r))) ⟶
        (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj G),
      IsIso ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor U.toScheme.toRingedSpace
        (⟨genericPoint Z, hx⟩ : U.toScheme)).map φ)
